dispositions.notes: Cites thm-normal-form (L1 uniqueness) and thm-word-quotient-model-is-free. Neither Statement changed: the normal form still reads "exactly one reduced word" and the universal-property theorem still concludes that the pair is a free group. My edits there were fact-restatement fidelity ([F1] reproducing the full reduction clauses, [L1] gaining the identity/inverse clause) plus one citation swap in step 1.2 to the congruence proposition. No premise this corollary uses was weakened.

Uses L3 (normal form) and L4 (word model is free) exactly as before; both Statements are unchanged in content. The def-word-quotient-model edit was additive notation fixing the formal-inverse involution, which this item already presumed implicitly. Its conclusion through thm-free-groups-unique-up-to-unique-isomorphism is untouched.

A changed interface, but only its frontmatter changed: I added justified_by pointing at thm-abelianisation-of-a-free-group-is-free-abelian to record the existence witness, matching the published def-free-group pattern. The Definition body is unchanged, so every consumer reads the same universal property. depcheck confirms the forward-justification target transitively depends on it.

Depends on thm-finite-free-bases-have-the-same-cardinality for single-valuedness. That Statement is unchanged; I only added [F1], the transport-along-a-bijection clause of def-finite-cardinality, and made step 2.1 name the bijection it counts through. Well-definedness of rank is licensed exactly as before, and the finite-basis restriction is unchanged.

The examples-cluster refuter found the Statement claimed "the free group on X" while the proof handled only the word model. Repaired by strengthening rather than weakening: the Example now reads "Every free group on X", deps gained thm-free-groups-unique-up-to-unique-isomorphism, facts [L3]/[L4] were added, and a new step 4.1 composes the generator-compatible isomorphism with the cyclic-group isomorphism. precheck passes.

Same defect class and same repair: the Example now reads "Every free group on the empty set is trivial", with [L2]/[L3] added and a new step 3.1 transporting triviality along the unique generator-compatible isomorphism. Strengthened, not weakened; precheck passes.

Cites L1 (normal form), L2 (word model is free) and L3 (uniqueness), and already performed the transport step that my two repairs added to its siblings, so it needed no change. None of its three cited Statements changed; their Facts restatements only gained previously omitted clauses, which can only strengthen the licensing of its step 3.1.

Both a changed interface and a consumer. The abelianisation-tietze refuter confirmed the title said "the free abelian group" while Statement and proof give only "a free abelian group", and this library proves no uniqueness theorem for free abelian groups. Title corrected to "The abelianisation of a free group on X is a free abelian group on X"; the Statement was already correct and is unchanged. Step 1.2 now also cites [F2], the generated-subgroup clause of def-commutator-and-commutator-subgroup. Statement provenance retagged ai-altered. As a consumer of def-free-abelian-group it is unaffected, that body being unchanged.

Both a changed interface and a consumer of def-word-quotient-model. Its Statement is unchanged. Repairs were citation-licensing only: [F1] now reproduces the reduced and freely-equivalent clauses the proof actually uses, a new [L3] states the congruence property, and step 1.2 cites [L3] rather than [F1] for transporting a free-equivalence sequence through a fixed suffix. As a consumer it is unaffected: the added involution paragraph only names notation this proof already used.

Consumer of def-word-quotient-model. The only change there is the added paragraph fixing the meaning of the formal inverse of a letter and recording that the pairing is an involution. This theorem step 3.1 and its Statement for the inverse of a class already relied on exactly that involution; the edit makes the notation explicit and changes no claim. Its own Statement and proof are untouched.

Both a changed interface and a consumer. Statement unchanged: the word-quotient group with its generator map is a free group on X in the sense of def-free-group. The repair was fact fidelity only, per the spine-universal refuter: [L1] now carries the identity and inverse clauses of thm-word-quotient-model-is-a-group that step 5.1 uses. As a consumer of def-word-quotient-model, unaffected for the same reason as the group theorem.
